title: A late close refuses a package holding a file Git ignores
description: A late close refuses a package holding a file Git ignores
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the late close match REQ-change-143: it moves a package that is committed on the remote default branch, byte for byte. The untracked-file check passed --exclude-standard, so a file Git ignores inside the package, never committed, did not block it and would be moved too.
acceptance_criteria: doctor --fix --close-late refuses a merged package that holds a file Git ignores, naming that the package differs from the remote default, and writes nothing (red then green)
